title: dedupeEvidence collapses distinct URLs when both snippets are empty or tokenize to <=2-char tokens
impact: Second and later distinct URLs silently dropped from evidence bundle
caller_impact: research-runtime.ts:490 evidence bundle loses sources; web_search unaffected (uses dedupeByUrl)
proposed_fix: Skip near-dup check when tok.size===0 (no similarity signal); add regression test

title: source is a free-form string, not a validated union type
evidence: search-provider-types.ts:7-8; mappers stamp brave|tavily|serper (brave.ts:44, tavily.ts:35, serper.ts:35)
impact: A mapper typo would flow into artifacts unchecked
proposed_fix: Type source as 'brave'|'tavily'|'serper' union; widen when providers added

title: No 429 retry/backoff in any provider
evidence: brave.ts:103-106, serper.ts:90-93, tavily.ts:97-100 (comment: ponytail no retry)
impact: Rate-limited provider counted as failed for that call only; no cross-call backoff
caller_impact: Callers see fewer results under throttling; loud aggregate warn
proposed_fix: Add bounded backoff honoring Retry-After if throttling observed (deferred by design)

title: Total failure vs genuine empty indistinguishable to callers (both return [])
impact: Code cannot branch on all-providers-failed; only console.warn distinguishes
proposed_fix: Optional result envelope {results, allFailed} or error signal in a coordinated change

title: Doc line-reference drift + missing Domain Spec/_index.md
evidence: SearchProviders.md cites research-runtime.ts:423/484/485/488 vs actual 429/490/491/494; Web search fan-out.md:11,23 same; no _index.md in re-docs/Backend Docs/Domain Spec/
impact: Docs misdirect readers on exact lines; AGENTS.md §3 requires per-root _index.md map
proposed_fix: Update line refs; add Domain Spec/_index.md map (docs work — not performed in this audit)

title: SearchProvider interface has no consumer; service uses typeof braveProvider
evidence: search-provider-types.ts:11-14; search-provider-service.ts:140; providers typed via interface (brave.ts:52)
impact: Interface drift risk if provider shapes diverge
proposed_fix: Type ProviderEntry as SearchProvider; keep interface as the port shape

title: Non-finite timeoutMs (NaN/Infinity) leads to immediate abort, not default
evidence: brave.ts:64, tavily.ts:55, serper.ts:55 (?? passes NaN/Infinity through); Node clamps setTimeout NaN/Infinity to 1ms
impact: Misuse-only: caller passing NaN/Infinity aborts instantly and counts as failed provider
caller_impact: No current caller passes non-finite (research-runtime.ts:429 passes 6000)

title: First-seen dedupe keeps row without timestamp when later duplicate has one
evidence: search-provider-service.ts:46-66 keeps first occurrence as-is; research-runtime.ts:490-491 sorts after dedupe
impact: Kept row can sort as unparsable (end of list) though a fresher copy had a timestamp
proposed_fix: Merge missing timestamp from duplicate onto kept row

title: No test for pre-aborted caller signal path in providers
No test for timeoutMs override via fake timers
impact: Timeout path only covered via mocked fetch throw
proposed_fix: Add fake-timer test asserting abort fires
